programme.title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape
programme.desc: Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. In 2004, with the internet still in its infancy, it only belatedly dawned on Argentina that 16-year-old Lionel Messi, who had broken through at FC Barcelona, ​​was on his way to obtaining Spanish nationality. A VHS tape of Messi's highlights was made and delivered to the Argentina association to make him an Argentina international. – Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. programme.title: UEFA Europa League archive: Wisła Kraków – Twente 14/12/2011 – 2011/2012 season
programme.desc: episode. In the program, viewers will see fragments of memorable matches played in the UEFA Europa League. From the 2009/2010 season, this competition replaced the previous UEFA Cup. The authors pay special attention to matches involving Polish clubs. The first Polish team to win the right to play in the LE group stage was Lech Poznań, later Wisła Kraków and Legia Warszawa also achieved this feat. The greatest success so far was promotion to the 1/16 finals of Lech in the 2010/2011 season, Legia and Wisła in the 2011/2012 season and Legia Warszawa in the 2014/2015 season

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League. FC Porto – Rangers FC
programme.desc: The Dragons from Porto lost two points in the previous round in Pilzno and dropped out of the top eight, which is guaranteed to take part in the 1/8 finals. They can return to it because their loss is minimal, but they must prove to be better than Rangers, who have already lost their chances of advancing to the next part of the competition.

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League. Aston Villa FC – FC Salzburg
programme.desc: The hosts are impressive in their form both domestically and in European cups. In the current edition of the Europa League, they lost only once - to Go Ahead Eagles (1-2), but since then they have won four in a row, including the last one over Fenerbahce (1-0). Aston Villa is already certain of promotion, taking second place in the table. The situation of the Austrians is definitely more difficult. RB Salzburg managed to win only two games and lost five. It takes a distant 28th place in the classification, and in order to advance to the play-off phase of the 1/16 finals, it must win in Birmingham and count on its rivals' mistakes.

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League. Panathinaikos AO – AS Roma
programme.desc: Rafael Benitez's team will host the team from Rome in the last, eighth round of the league phase of the current edition of the Europa League. The Clovers face a difficult challenge, because AS Roma is impressive in its form in European cups, winning the previous four matches, including the last one against VfB Stuttgart (2-0). Panathinaikos AO has also not lost in four matches, but in its case it is divided into two wins and draws. In the previous match, the Greek team drew with Ferencvaros (1:1)

programme.title: Piłka nożna: Liga Europy UEFA. Nottingham Forest FC – Ferencvárosi TC
programme.desc: Drzewy lost hope of directly advancing to the 1/8 finals of the current edition of the Europa League after a defeat in the previous round against Braga (0:1). Nottingham Forest therefore approaches the match without any major goals, with a certain place that would allow them to advance to the round of 16. The guests from Hungary, however, are still fighting to maintain their place in the top eight, which gives them direct promotion to the 1/8 finals. In the previous match, Ferencvaros drew 1-1 with Panathinaikos, which made the fight for higher places more difficult.

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League – play-off match: PAOK FC – Celta Vigo
programme.desc: The Greek team will face Celta Vigo in the first match of the play-off phase. Interestingly, both teams faced each other in the current edition of the Europa League in the league phase - then the Spanish club came out on top, winning at their own stadium 3:1. However, Greek fans can look at the upcoming clash with optimism. PAOK is doing well in the league, with a five-match unbeaten record. The Polish accent of this match may be the performance of Tomasz Kędziora, whose form has been impressive in recent matches

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League – play-off match: Panathinaikos AO – FC Viktoria Plzeň
programme.desc: Rafael Benítez's team will face Viktoria Plzeň in the first match of the play-off phase. The Greek team started the game badly, but after hiring a Spanish coach, Panathinaikos' game improved and the Koniczynki team recorded five games in a row without defeat. During this period, there was also the first clash with Viktoria Plzeň, which ended in a goalless draw.

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League – Round of 16 match: VfB Stuttgart – FC Porto
programme.desc: Sebastian Hoeness's team will face FC Porto in the 1/8 finals of the Europa League. VfB Stuttgart will have to use the home advantage in the first match, especially since the Portuguese are in poorer form in away matches. Jan Bednarek and company drew the last league match with Benfica 2:2, and one of the goals was scored by Oskar Pietruszewski. However, we will not see the young winger, brought from Jagiellonia, in the Europa League because he was not registered for the competition.

programme.desc: The Pride of Podlasie started the league phase of the youngest UEFA competition with a modest victory over Hamrun Spartans 1-0. In the second round, Adrian Siemieniec's players faced the strong RC Strasbourg, drawing with them away 1-1. Now they are on a delegation to Skopje. KF Shkendija has a 0-2 defeat against Rayo Vallecano and a 1-0 victory over Shelbourne FC. Jagiellonia will be the favorite in the match at the stadium. Todor Proeski. If only she would play her role better than the Lech Poznań players in the confrontation with Lincoln Red Imps from Gibraltar

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Lech Poznań – FC Lausanne-Sport
programme.desc: Kolejorz lost the previous two matches in the Conference League - first, they unexpectedly lost to Lincoln Red Imps 1-2, and then they lost to Rayo Vallecano (2-3). Stopping the bad series against the undefeated team from Switzerland in this edition of the competition will not be an easy task

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Raków Częstochowa – SK Rapid Vienna
programme.desc: The team from Częstochowa, which is in twelfth place in the Conference League table, will play against the team that is closing the table. On October 2, Lech Poznań defeated Rapid Wien 4:1. Will Fran Tudor and his colleagues from Raków follow in Kolejorz's footsteps?

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Legia Warszawa – AC Sparta Prague
programme.desc: At the beginning of November, Military, plunged into crisis, even lost at home to Bruk-Bet Termalica. They're not doing too well in the UEFA Conference League either. After three rounds, they only have three points on the counter. If they do not score points against Sparta, their advancement to the play-offs will become unlikely

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Jagiellonia Białystok – KuPS Kuopio
programme.desc: At the halfway point of the regular phase of the Conference League, Pride of Podlasie is in thirteenth place, which guarantees seeding in the play-off phase. Adrian Siemieniec's players remain undefeated, but they cannot be proud of their last performance. They only drew 1-1 with Macedonian Shkendija and scored the equalizing goal in the tenth minute of added time. Jagiellonia has a match against KuPS Kuopio, which, like itself, has five points. The team from Finland will take the field in Białystok encouraged by their 3-1 victory over Slovan Bratislava in the previous round

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Lech Poznań – 1. FSV Mainz 05
programme.desc: The team from Mainz is defending itself against relegation from the Bundesliga, but at the halfway point of the regular phase of the Conference League it had all the points and was guaranteed promotion to the play-off phase. Kolejorz is facing a difficult ordeal, but if he managed to win, he would also be sure of playing in the rest of the competition.

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Raków Częstochowa – HSK Zrinjski Mostar

programme.title: Football: 2026 World Cup – Group L match: Panama – Croatia
programme.desc: In Group L, England and Croatia have the best chance of advancing to the knockout phase. The team from the Balkans will face Panama in the second match and they remain the favorites in this match. Croatians are certainly aiming to repeat the successes of 2018 and 2022, when they finished the World Cup in second and third place, respectively. This is only the second World Championship for Panama - they previously participated in the tournament in 2018

programme.title: Football: 2026 World Cup – Group K match: Colombia – Democratic Republic of the Congo
programme.desc: Colombia is the unexpected leader of the Group K table after the first round. In the inaugural match, they defeated Uzbekistan 3-1. It also owes its place to the fantastic performance of the Democratic Republic of Congo players, who made a huge surprise in the previous round by drawing with favored Portugal 1-1.

programme.title: Football: 2026 World Cup – Group B match: Bosnia and Herzegovina – Qatar
programme.desc: This clash will probably determine the team that will take third place in group B. After two rounds, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Qatar have one point each. Julen Lopetegui's players are in a worse situation, as they have a weaker goal difference

programme.title: Football: 2026 World Cup – Group C match: Morocco – Haiti
Football: 2026 World Cup – Group A match: South Africa – South Korea

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Lechia Gdańsk – Motor Lublin
programme.desc: In the last competition, Lechia Gdańsk fans could not be sure that their team would remain in the highest league almost until the last round. The team from Tricity wants the current campaign to be better and, above all, calmer. We will see how the team from Gdańsk will perform in the confrontation with Motor Lublin

programme.title: Ekstraklasa after hours
programme.desc: Summary of recent events in the Ekstraklasa. In addition to serious analyzes of last weekend's matches, the authors of the program also present interesting facts from the league with a wink and a hint of irony. They present the profiles of football players and coaches, including foreign stars, and also reveal the secrets of training and events in the locker rooms. They also present funny comments, memes and comics written by fans... a football magazine

programme.title: Wisła Cupiała | E01
programme.desc: The fate of Wisła Kraków during the reign of Bogusław Cupiał. It was a time of sporting successes, dramatic failures, an exciting fight for the Champions League and difficult relationships with fans. It is a look at a club that is a symbol of power and unfulfilled aspirations. Bogusław Cupiał is one of the richest Poles at the turn of the 20th and 21st centuries. In 1997, he invested in Wisła Kraków. We look at his beginnings at the club. We learn about motivation and management philosophy. His relationship with the team, which he treated as a life project, was unique. Poland. 2025. documentary series

programme.title: Wisła Cupiała | E02
programme.desc: The fate of Wisła Kraków during the reign of Bogusław Cupiał. It was a time of sporting successes, dramatic failures, an exciting fight for the Champions League and difficult relationships with fans. It is a look at a club that is a symbol of power and unfulfilled aspirations. Since throwing a knife at a Parma player by a hooligan nicknamed Misiek in 1998, Wisła Kraków fans began to play an increasingly important role in the club's life. The team's successes increased interest in the matches, contributing to the influx of new fans. However, along with the great popularity, more and more serious problems appeared in the stands, which the club's authorities were unable to cope with. Poland. 2025. documentary series

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Jagiellonia Białystok – Cracovia
programme.desc: The pride of Podlasie has not been able to defeat the Pasy team in front of its home audience since spring 2021. If Cracovia's players show their form from the beginning of the season, it may be difficult for Jagiellonia Białystok to break their bad streak.

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Legia Warszawa – GKS Katowice
programme.desc: A week ago, Legia Warszawa's offensive was unable to crush the well-organized defense of Arka Gdynia. The newcomer quite unexpectedly took away a goalless draw from the capital, which was met with great disappointment among the Military fans. A similar stumble in the match against GKS Katowice may only increase their frustration

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Arka Gdynia – Pogoń Szczecin
programme.desc: A week ago, Arka Gdynia faced Legia at Łazienkowska Street in Warsaw, and although they did not show great ball, they managed to draw a goalless draw in the capital. This time, the newcomer will try to challenge another favorite - Pogoń Szczecin, which still cannot gain momentum.

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Widzew Łódź – Wisła Płock
programme.desc: A week ago, Widzew Łódź's goalkeeper was unexpectedly missing Rafał Gikiewicz, who was replaced by Maciej Kikolski in the match against GKS Katowice. programme.title: I was a king – Włodzimierz Lubański | S01E01
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. The first episode is devoted to the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański. In the years 1963-175 he played for Górnik Zabrze. He scored 155 goals for him. He was the top scorer four times in a row (1966-1969). Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Football: Spanish league: RCD Espanyol – FC Barcelona
programme.desc: In theory, the league schedule gives the Pride of Catalonia a chance to welcome 2026 in style. The defeat in the Barcelona derby is something that has been happening to it for a long time. The last one took place eight years ago, when Espanyol defeated their more successful rival from behind 1-0 in the quarter-finals of the King's Cup. However, it was a pyrrhic victory. Ernesto Valverde's team at that time reversed the two-legged tie in the second leg at Camp Nou and celebrated promotion to the next phase of the competition. In the 2025/26 league campaign, the Parrots have arguments to pose a real threat to Blaugrana, who are aiming for the championship. The team from Estadi Cornella-El Prat achieved a series of victories in November and December. She defeated, among others: Sevilla, Celta and Athletic, which moved it to fifth place in the table, which resulted in promotion to the European cups. The meeting with the Pride of Catalonia will be a maturity exam for Espanyol. If the Parrots take points away from Hansi Flick's team, they will show that they can still cause a stir at the top of La Liga

programme.title: 30 for 30: I'm Just Here for the Riot
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Scientific nonsense. 11 p.

programme.title: Scientific nonsense. 17 p.

programme.title: Scientific nonsense. 18 p.
programme.desc: In this episode, you'll learn even more ways to hurt yourself and embarrass yourself while doing a backflip on a bike, jumping on a raft, or passing someone on the track. Dir.: Marcus Rutledge. Led by: Richard Hammond. USA, 2014, documentary, scientific and educational

programme.title: d/s Air crash investigations. 5 s.
programme.desc: The twin-engine Embraer begins to move erratically in the skies over Portugal, and the pilots of Air Astana Flight 1388 fight for their lives for more than an hour. Finally, they realize that the aircraft that had undergone maintenance was returned with a dangerous malfunction. Dir.: George D'Amato, James Hislop. Cast: Jason Weinberg, Bill Lake, Dennis Akayama, Jerry Mendicino, Hrant Alyanak, Jean-Marc Fontaine, Brendan Wall. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003, documentary

programme.title: d/s Air crash investigations. 6 p.
programme.desc: Sichuan Airlines Flight 8633 flies high over the Himalayas. Suddenly the windshield cracks and flies out. Due to a sudden depressurization, the co-pilot is half pulled out of the cockpit. The commander has to pilot alone. Dir.: George D'Amato, James Hislop. Cast: Jason Weinberg, Bill Lake, Dennis Akayama, Jerry Mendicino, Hrant Alyanak, Jean-Marc Fontaine, Brendan Wall. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003, documentary

programme.title: d/s World Eats Bread (Bread from San Francisco)
programme.desc: In the US, where store-bought bread reigns supreme, sourdough is going against the grain—and it's doing best in the counterculture bastion of California's Bay Area.

programme.title: d/s The world eats bread (Tortillas from Guatemala)
programme.desc: In Guatemala, where the ancient Mayans believed the gods created people from corn, the tortilla is the centerpiece of every meal. Today, a group of chefs, farmers and activists are fighting to give the tortilla its due.

programme.title: d/s The world eats bread (Pide from Turkey)
programme.desc: The Fertile Crescent is the region where the first seeds of bread were planted thousands of years ago. To this day, Türkiye eats it more than any other country. This is a story about two of the most beloved types of bread: simit and pide.

programme.title: d/f Mars and SpaceX
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in the exciting story of how dreams of going to Mars are becoming a reality thanks to SpaceX's innovative technologies. You will find unique footage of rocket tests, interviews with engineers and scientists, as well as a detailed analysis of plans for the colonization of Mars. What difficulties must be overcome to make the Red Planet a new home for humanity, and why now this goal is closer than ever. USA

programme.title: d/f Mission to the Sun
programme.desc: In July 2018, NASA will launch the first ever mission to a star. This is a truly historical quest dedicated to the study of the largest object in our solar system - the Sun. To implement it, the fastest aircraft ever created on Earth is being created, which will fly at a speed of 450,000 miles per hour. Its mission, incredibly complex, will be to penetrate the “atmosphere” of our star and obtain facts that will change our understanding of its structure. This documentary explores the amazing nature of our Sun, a mission that will change the way we think about the world around us. We will find out all the details of this NASA mission. This documentary, released simultaneously with the delivery of the probe to the “atmosphere” of the Sun (November 2018) and the corresponding information boom that will accompany this event, is dedicated to a key moment in human history, the attempt to “touch” the Sun. USA

programme.title: d/f Witnesses of the Japanese disaster
programme.desc: On March 11, 2011, Japan experienced one of the most devastating natural disasters in its history. A powerful earthquake with a magnitude of 9.0 caused a tsunami that hit the country's east coast, destroying entire cities and leaving thousands of people homeless. The documentary chronicles these tragic events, revealing how the country faced an unprecedented disaster. You will see unique footage of the destruction filmed by eyewitnesses, and hear the stories of survivors who managed to escape in those terrible minutes. USA

Africa's Wild Horizons: Ghosts of Cederberg (S2E1). Documentary about nature, adventure. USA, 2016. S2, Ep1
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S2, Ep1 «Africa's Wild Horizons»…A rocky landscape, carved over eons by wind, water and fire, these are the Cederberg Mountains of South Africa. These imposing peaks are home to an incredible diversity of plants and animals. But there are some here that remain unseen, lurking in the shadows and ready to strike at any time…Africa's Wild Horizons is a documentary series that takes the viewers on a fantastic journey to Africa's lands, completely untouched by civilization. Feel its untamed wilderness, uncover mystical secrets, explore its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna, home to iconic animals and creatures of all possible kinds, where every day is an endless struggle for survival, and only the strongest stays alive. Take a look at Waterberg- a South African land formed before terrestrial life itself, the Vredefort Dome- a crater left after a giant meteorite crash, Swaziland's endless savanna, ecosystem of the Kalahari and the Okavango and much more.Director: Christopher D.Z. Mason

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas: Canada (S1E6). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2021. S1, Ep6
programme.desc: 2021 г. Год: 2021. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2021. S1, Ep6 «Battle of the Alphas»…Canada, where summer is short and time is tight – any time is the right time to fight. The mighty North provides the setting for bison, bald eagles, and polar bears to wage some of the most heavy-duty fighting in the animal kingdomFrom turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, our planet is a battleground as animals go head to head with their own kind, in Battle of the AlphasDirector: Karen McCairleyCast: Mark Clermont

programme.title: Arabian Seas: A Turtle's Legacy (S1E5). Documentary about nature. England, 2017. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2017. S1, Ep5 «Arabian Seas»…The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangeredArabian Seas is a nature documentary series revealing the secrets of the mysterious Arabian waters, barely known to the rest of the world. This aquatic paradise is home to thousands of fascinating creatures, from endangered turtles, mysterious huge sharks and deadly rays to tiny shrimps and reef fish, zebra sharks and cuttlefish- camouflage kings. This marine heritage is splendid, but much of it is very vulnerable and in need of protectionDirector: Harley Smith, Dan ChambersCast: Andrew Clark

programme.title: Animals Like Us: Pirate Birds (S1E4) (Bizim Gibi Davranan Hayvanlar). Documentary about nature. England, 2023. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S1, Ep4 «Bizim Gibi Davranan Hayvanlar»…Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephant's secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective matesPeek inside the lives of penguins, giraffes, chimps, and other animals that behave a whole lot like humans. Touch down on all seven continents around the world to see why these wild creatures compete, co-operate, love, and grieve just like we doDirector: Stuart StricksonCast: Anna Leong Brophy, Gillian Burke, Lucy Cooke

programme.title: Zambia Untamed: The Outcasts (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2018. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S1, Ep1 «Zambia Untamed»…In the Luangwa Valley lies a grove of Ebony trees, home to a troop of baboons. But, there are dangers here – the resident leopard who, unlike the other predators, is powerful and agile enough to climb trees. He's not an easy foe to eludeIn a magical corner of Zambia lies an extraordinary valley – a place where Africa's most charismatic animals live shoulder to shoulder. This series tells enchanting stories about the characters who call this place home, from the struggles of a baby elephant to a baboon born an outsider. From the smallest, to the tallest, a cast of engaging and intriguing animals brings this untamed African wonderland to lifeDirector: Beth Brooks

programme.title: Zambia Untamed: Living on the Edge (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2018. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S1, Ep2 «Zambia Untamed»…The plains and woodlands of the Luangwa Valley are the wildest and most merciless of all neighbourhoods where duels between predator and prey are played out both day and night. For the animals that call this home, it's a daily battle to stay aliveIn a magical corner of Zambia lies an extraordinary valley – a place where Africa's most charismatic animals live shoulder to shoulder. This series tells enchanting stories about the characters who call this place home, from the struggles of a baby elephant to a baboon born an outsider. From the smallest, to the tallest, a cast of engaging and intriguing animals brings this untamed African wonderland to lifeDirector: Mitch Turnbull

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests: Seasonal (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2023. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S1, Ep2 «Secrets of the Enchanted Forests»…Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fallTraverse the planet's richest and most diverse woodlands – from the tropics to the poles and everywhere in between – and learn how forests connect and nurture the lives of countless speciesDirector: Laura Coates, Mark ThorpCast: Fenella Fudge

programme.title: Brazil Untamed: Capybara's Pond (S1E7). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep7
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep7 «Brazil Untamed»…At the northern edge of the Pantanal, in one of the largest tropical wetlands on Earth, is a small pond that is home to an unusual family of rodents. They are not your typical rats or squirrels – these giants are the size of sheep! And in the middle of the dry season, this group has more than a dozen babies to raise and keep safe. It is a challenge because as big as they are, these gentle giants are on the menu of lots of predatorsThe mesmerising wildlife of Brazil is revealed in this fascinating documentary series. Focussing on the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetlands, a team of scientists and camera crew study the remarkable creatures that inhabit the area. Predominantly located in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, though also spreading into Mato Grosso, as well as Bolivia and Paraguay, this unique ecosystem is home to some of Brazil's most captivating species. The team work day and night to track these wonderful animals, including Capuchin monkeys, jaguars, giant otters, maned wolves, capybaras and a wealth of exotic birdsDirector: Emmanuelle Wiecha

S1, Ep7 «Brazil Untamed»…At the northern edge of the Pantanal, in one of the largest tropical wetlands on Earth, is a small pond that is home to an unusual family of rodents. programme.desc: Ăn nhẹ trong bữa tiệc đồ ăn kinh hoàng từ quá khứ: từ nước tăng lực phóng xạ đến đồ ăn nhẹ đầy tai tiếng làm từ Olestra, chúng tôi khám phá ra những thứ đáng kinh ngạc mà con người từng ăn mà không cần đắn đo.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP09
programme.desc: Đằng sau những cuộc đụng độ khốc liệt ở tiền tuyến trong Thế chiến thứ hai, một trận chiến ẩn giấu đang diễn ra ác liệt. Ở vùng nông thôn nước Anh, một nhóm học giả xuất sắc nỗ lực giải mã Bí ẩn 'không thể phá vỡ' của Đức và thay đổi cục diện cuộc chiến.

programme.title: HIDDEN CITIES S2 EP02
programme.desc: Một đô thị hiện đại được định hình bởi chiến tranh, chủ nghĩa thực dân và nền văn hóa đa dạng; những viên ngọc lịch sử ẩn giấu vẫn có thể được tìm thấy ở một trong những thành phố tương lai nhất thế giới.

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP17
programme.desc: Con người có thể sống sót sau những chấn thương thảm khốc và những tình huống chết người bất chấp nghịch cảnh theo những cách không thể giải thích được. Phải chăng việc lừa dối cái chết khi việc sống sót dường như là không thể chỉ đơn giản là số phận hay vận may?

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP11
programme.desc: Khi trăng tròn khiến đàn cá sấu phát cuồng, Ashley mắc phải một sai lầm nghiêm trọng. Daniel đuổi theo chân 13 huyền thoại có tên Triple XL. Troy và Pickle chiến đấu với mối đe dọa cuồng nhiệt từ mặt trăng với sở thích ăn thịt cá sấu.

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S1 EP06
programme.desc: Hãy hình dung thế này: mặt nạ phòng độc toàn thân cho trẻ sơ sinh. Thế còn Smell-o-Vision thì sao? Hoặc một robot được cung cấp năng lượng bằng cách ăn sên? Đây đều là những phát minh thực sự và chúng tôi đã đề cập đến chúng.

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP18
programme.desc: Khi nhóm Oak Island đào được một vị trí đắc địa trong khu vực Money Pit, họ phát hiện ra những manh mối tuyệt vời có thể xác định được ai đứng đằng sau bí ẩn kho báu 230 năm tuổi.

programme.title: SECRETS DECLASSIFIED WITH DAVID DUCHOVNY S1 EP09
programme.desc: Mặc dù không gian luôn là biên giới cuối cùng nhưng nó cũng là biên giới không thể biết trước mà mọi quốc gia đều muốn trở thành người đầu tiên chinh phục. Cuối cùng, các tài liệu mới được công bố cho chúng ta cái nhìn thoáng qua về kế hoạch của họ.

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP06
programme.desc: Lauro thúc đẩy việc tập luyện của Iditarod ở tốc độ cao với cuộc chạy 300 dặm trên Đường cao tốc Denali; Bret và Ivy chuyển từ kiểm tra bẫy sang săn nai sừng tấm và nhân cơ hội hạ gục một con bò đực lớn.

programme.title: CUỘC CHIẾN TÀN KHỐC - CRUEL WAR
programme.desc: Để chống lại hiệu ứng nhà kính, nhà khoa học Yan Xin cố gắng trồng những hạt giống siêu cao su mới được phát triển trên một hòn đảo xa xôi với hy vọng biến nó thành một vùng đất mới thịnh vượng. Chồng cũ của Yan Xin quyết định đồng hành cùng cô trên hành trình đầy nguy hiểm này. Khi xung đột nảy sinh, họ chạm trán với băng đảng ma túy địa phương và một trận chiến sinh tử sắp bắt đầu.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: THẠCH HẦU TRỞ VỀ - THE MONKEY IS BACK
programme.desc: Vị cứu tinh của mọi người, Stone Monkey, đã mang lại hy vọng cho một cô bé tuyệt vọng mà anh hứa sẽ nhận ra. Nhiều năm sau, Stone Monkey bị đánh bại trong trận chiến với Thần chiến tranh ba mắt, khiến hắn mất đi sức mạnh và rơi xuống phàm trần. Liệu anh ta có thể thực hiện lời hứa của mình với cô gái và ngăn chặn Thần Rừng hủy diệt trái đất?

programme.title: CHIẾN BINH THỰC TẾ ẢO - VR FIGHTER
programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời thử nghiệm sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.title: TAY ĐẤM HUYỀN THOẠI - FIST OF LEGEND
programme.desc: Khi Chen Zhen học ở Nhật Bản, anh phát hiện một số sinh viên Trung Quốc mất tích và vô tình phát hiện ra âm mưu của Hội Rồng Đen. Một loại thuốc mới được phát minh để tăng cường sức khỏe cho quân đội Nhật Bản trong chiến tranh và các sinh viên Trung Quốc được sử dụng trong thí nghiệm của họ. Chen Zhen thề sẽ tiêu diệt tổ chức tà ác và phá hủy phòng thí nghiệm bí mật của chúng.

Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: THIÊN SƯ NÚI MAO - MAOSHAN HEAVENLY MASTER
programme.desc: Tù nhân Chi bỏ trốn dưới sự giám hộ của Master Zhang, khiến người này bị trục xuất khỏi gia tộc của mình. Trên đường đi tìm Chi, Master Zhang đến một nơi mà nhiều người biến mất không lý do. Anh ta sớm phát hiện ra rằng chính Chi đã bắt họ trong quá trình huấn luyện để trở thành quỷ rắn. Cuộc chiến giữa con người và quỷ vừa mới bắt đầu!

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!
